title: The role of locality and weight sharing in convolutional neural networks
abstract: arXiv:2610.30118v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The success of convolutional neural networks is often attributed to locality and weight sharing. However, how these two properties separately shape learning, and how their effects depend on the spatial correlations of natural images, remain poorly understood. We address these questions in a teacher-student model with a convolutional teacher acting on $P$ input positions with correlation $c$ between positions. We compare convolutional and locally connected students trained by online stochastic gradient descent, and derive ordinary differential equations that describe their dynamics exactly in the limit of large feature dimension $D$. For uncorrelated positions ($c = 0$), the two students follow the same learning trajectory, with the convolutional student learning exactly $P$ times faster. We also find that locality affects the sample complexity: a student that matches the kernel size of the teacher recovers it from $\mathcal{O}_{D}(D)$ sa

translated_title: 局部性与权重共享在卷积神经网络中的作用
translated_abstract: 卷积神经网络的成功通常被归因于局部性和权重共享。然而，这两个特性如何分别塑造学习过程，以及它们的影响如何依赖于自然图像的空间相关性，仍然知之甚少。我们在一个师生模型中研究这些问题，其中一个卷积教师作用于 $P$ 个输入位置，位置之间的相关性为 $c$。我们比较了通过在线随机梯度下降训练的卷积学生与局部连接学生，并推导出在大特征维度 $D$ 极限下能精确描述其动力学的常微分方程。对于不相关的位置（$c = 0$），两个学生遵循相同的学习轨迹，而卷积学生的学习速度恰好快 $P$ 倍。我们还发现局部性会影响样本复杂度：与教师核大小相匹配的学生能够从 $\mathcal{O}_{D}(D)$ 个样本中恢复教师……
tldr: 本研究通过师生模型的精确动力学分析揭示：卷积网络中权重共享带来的学习加速与输入位置数 $P$ 成正比，而局部性则决定样本复杂度，二者的影响均依赖于输入位置间的空间相关性。
en_tdlr: Through exact dynamics analysis in a teacher-student model, this work shows that weight sharing in convolutional neural networks yields a learning speed-up exactly proportional to the number of input positions, while locality governs sample complexity, with both effects depending on the spatial correlations of the inputs.
